name: The CLI runs on Linux x86-64 and macOS Apple silicon
One region, one control plane
note: A machine that fails is replaced in minutes, not seconds.

name: No GPUs
note: There is no way to ask for a runner of a particular kind.

name: Linux guests only
note: Booted with the kernel spin provides.

name: No IPv6 inside a workspace
TCP only for published ports
A diff does not see everything
note: A file is hashed only when its size, inode or times changed; extended attributes are not compared.

name: A memory snapshot resumes only on the same machine
note: The same QEMU, guest kernel and guest init; a disk restore has no such limit.

name: Disk chains have a limit
note: At the limit the top layer grows instead, so less of the recent work is in the bucket.

name: Work since the last upload can be lost
note: A runner uploads writes in layers, on the RPO, on snapshot and on stop; what it had not uploaded goes with it.

name: No multi-factor authentication of Spin's own
note: Sign in through a provider that enforces it.

name: No invitations
note: A person signs in once before they can be added to a team.

name: Team roles are fixed
Nothing pages anyone
note: Metrics, logs and traces stay inside the installation; there are no alerts.

name: An update is one way
note: A release older than the one that last started the database refuses to start on it.
